blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Education (DepEd) has issued the guidelines for the 2026 National Literacy Awards (NLA), reaffirming its commitment to recognize partners helping advance literacy in communities nationwide. DepEd issued Memorandum No. 062, s. 2026, which contains the guidelines, through the Literacy Coordinating Council (LCC). According to a DepEd statement issued on Wednesday, the memo provides that the NLA will guide DepEd central and field offices, concerned agencies, and partner organizations in recognizing outstanding programs that significantly contribute to advancing literacy in the country.
